keyframe_review.note: New keyframe (Cliopatria has no Kaabu row; its Mali shape covers Guinea-Bissau and the Gambia). Kaabu is drawn from the page's own description: north-eastern Guinea-Bissau with parts of the Gambia and the Casamance, Koussanar and Koumpentoum. No area on the page. "The number of provinces grew from three to seven" after Mali's decline (undated); Kantora, Tumana and Mana were vassal provinces.

wars.name: Fula-Mandinka wars against Kaabu (Soninke-Marabout Wars)

zones.text: north-eastern Guinea-Bissau, the heart of Kaabu with the capital Kansala

wars.outcome: From 1776 the Torodbe state in the Futa Djallon "launched a jihad against non-Muslim states in the region, particularly Kaabu"; Kaabu repulsed Fula armies at Berekolong until the 1860s, when Futa Jallon and rebel Fula from Kaabu (Alfa Molo) took Kansala.

wars.name: Battle of Kansala

zones.text: north-eastern Guinea-Bissau, the heart of Kaabu with the capital Kansala

wars.outcome: Victory of Futa Jallon: Kansala was surrounded for one to three months, held for eleven days, and destroyed on 24 May 1867; Alfa Molo established Fuladu.
wars.note: Listed as 13 May to 24 May 1867; the Futa Jallon page dates the invasion to 1865.

certainty.note: The pages give no frontier, only the countries and districts the kingdom lay in.

notes:
Kaabu (Gabu), additions batch af-03-x; Cliopatria has no row. Pages: Kaabu, Battle of Kansala, Imamate of Futa Jallon.

Conflicts: Fuladu "gained its independence" (Kaabu page) versus Imamate control extended into it in 1867 (Futa Jallon page); the Kaabu infobox gives 1537-1867 while the text has Kansala under Fula control to c. 1900 and the "total incorporation of the remaining kingdoms" at the turn of the century. The mali-empire dossier holds a 1537 loss to kaabu over the whole of Guinea-Bissau and the Gambia, which is larger than the page-based shape here; the extent is thin (no area). The Futa Jallon page dates the invasion to 1865, the Kansala page to c. 1864-1867.

Not on the pages: Kaabu's founding year (1230s, infobox), the dates of its provincial growth, Jolof or Geba-Corubal relations (the page does not mention Jolof). Needs dossiers: fuladu (1867-c.1900, Alpha Molo Balde), imamate-of-futa-jallon (written in this batch), portuguese-guinea. Gazetteer: Kansala, Berekolong, Fuladu (region), Kantora, Tumana, Mana.
